theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom_const {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] :
homotopyGroupHom (ContinuousMap.const X y) ⋯ = 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom_apply {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (q : HomotopyGroup N X x) :
(homotopyGroupHom f hf) q = homotopyGroupMap f hf q

def QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) :
HomotopyGroup N X x →* HomotopyGroup N Y y

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.one_eq_const_mk {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] :
1 = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.genLoopMap_transAt {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} [DecidableEq N] (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (i : N) (a b : ↑(GenLoop N X x)) :
genLoopMap f hf (GenLoop.transAt i a b) = GenLoop.transAt i (genLoopMap f hf a) (genLoopMap f hf b)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap_const {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} (q : HomotopyGroup N X x) :
homotopyGroupMap (ContinuousMap.const X y) ⋯ q = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap_comp {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} {Z : Type uZ} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace Z] {x : X} {y : Y} {z : Z} (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (g : C(Y, Z)) (hg : g y = z) :
homotopyGroupMap (g.comp f) ⋯ = homotopyGroupMap g hg ∘ homotopyGroupMap f hf

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap_id {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) :
homotopyGroupMap (ContinuousMap.id X) ⋯ = id

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap_mk {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (g : ↑(GenLoop N X x)) :
homotopyGroupMap f hf ⟦g⟧ = ⟦genLoopMap f hf g⟧

def QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) :
HomotopyGroup N X x → HomotopyGroup N Y y

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.genLoopMap_homotopic {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) {g₁ g₂ : ↑(GenLoop N X x)} (h : GenLoop.Homotopic g₁ g₂) :
GenLoop.Homotopic (genLoopMap f hf g₁) (genLoopMap f hf g₂)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.genLoopMap_apply {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (g : ↑(GenLoop N X x)) (t : N → ↑unitInterval) :
(genLoopMap f hf g) t = f (g t)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.genLoopMap_coe {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (g : ↑(GenLoop N X x)) :
↑(genLoopMap f hf g) = f.comp ↑g

def QOU.Mathlib.HomotopyGroupFunctor.genLoopMap {N : Type uN} {X : Type uX} {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {x : X} {y : Y} (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (g : ↑(GenLoop N X x)) :
↑(GenLoop N Y y)
